CASE PUD 2026-000046 ENTRY NO. 46 FILED IN OCC COURT CLERK'S OFFICE ON 09/22/2026 - PAGE 1 OF 2




           BEFORE THE CORPORATION COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF OKLAHOMA

         IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF                      )
         OKLAHOMA GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY                        )
         FOR AN ORDER OF THE COMMISSION                           )
         APPROVING ITS NEW EXTRA LARGE LOAD                       )
         TARIFF AND TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF                       )     CASE NO. PUD2026-0000XX
         SERVICE FOR EXTRA LARGE LOAD                             )
         CUSTOMERS AND A REGULATORY ASSET TO                      )
         RECOVER COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH                            )
         PORTFOLIO OPTIMIZATION SOFTWARE                          )

                                            NOTICE OF HEARING

                NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that Oklahoma Gas and Electric Company has filed a
         Motion to Amend the Procedural Schedule in Order No. 758969 to Include a Briefing
         Schedule Regarding Proposals for Alternative Electric Service Frameworks in the above-
         captioned case.

                NOTICE IS FURTHER GIVEN that the Motion will be heard before the Administrative
         Law Judge on October 1, 2026, at 8:30 a.m., in the Concourse Theater, Suite C50, Will Rogers
         Memorial Building in the Capitol Complex at 2401 N. Lincoln Blvd., Oklahoma City, OK 73105.
         The Concourse Theater is located in the tunnel between the Will Rogers Memorial Office Building
         and the Sequoyah Office Building.

                NOTICE IS FURTHER GIVEN that all interested persons may appear and be heard
         regarding the Motion, and after hearing and consideration of the recommendations of the
         Administrative Law Judge, the Commission will issue such orders and grant such relief as it deems
         reasonable, fair, necessary, proper and equitable, whether or not specifically prayed for in the
         Motion.

                 NOTICE IS FURTHER GIVEN for information concerning this Motion, contact A. Chase
         Snodgrass, Deborah R. Thompson, or Kenneth A. Tillotson, Thompson Tillotson PLLC, P.O. Box
         54632, Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, 73154, (405) 213-1000, attorneys for Oklahoma Gas and
         Electric Company.


         OKLAHOMA CORPORATION COMMISSION

         KIM DAVID, Chairman
         J. TODD HIETT, Commissioner
         BRIAN BINGMAN, Commissioner
